title: PDV Phase 20 Dunmer ancestor substrate and Reclamation foreground implementation costing
auditScope: P2 audit-only. Transcribes the Dunmer hook contracts, anti-farm rules, contexts, and stack snapshot from PDV_Phase20_NoInGameProof_Gates.json into the costing schema. No new reward volume beyond the gate/ledger ceiling (ancestor substrate plus one Reclamation foreground).
designRules: Dunmer is layered, not path-based: ancestor ash-prayer is always active, the Good Daedra deepen it, one Reclamation focus adds weight on top.
Do NOT implement PDV_State_DunmerPath; native focus uses shared patron state (one Reclamation foreground at a time).
Ancestor substrate has NO passive decay; Skyrim lacks proper tombs and House shrines, and that absence must not punish the player.
Do not let all three Good Daedra plus the ancestor substrate plus deviation paths pay as equal foreground packages.
Tribunal memory stays flavor-only, never a controllable blessing machine.
Non-Reclamation Daedric or curse deviation carries visible price, stigma, exit, or residue through the global Daedric system (R6), not a clean third reward path.
Ancestor substrate stays quiet/identity-heavy; the Reclamation foreground carries most of the power (strong substrate overstack flag).

stateSurfaces.storageKeyContract: PDV.Substrate.DunmerAncestor.* (PrayerCount, HomeCount; metric/tier carried by PDV_SubstrateBase).
notes: Tracks ancestor practice (portable ash-prayer, player-home rite) quietly behind the always-active ancestor layer.
NO passive dawn decay per the ledger; the layer is identity/utility, not a maintenance treadmill.
Concrete proving helper exposes RecordPortableShrinePrayer/RecordPlayerHomeBonus (PrayerDelta 5.0, HomeBonusDelta 8.0) feeding the SubstrateBase metric.
Normal is the healthy diaspora ancestor connection; Strained is medium creed drift.
Silent is the curse/major-deviation posture where neglect bite applies; RestoredScarred is post-curse return that keeps a visible scar without permanent punishment.
Ancestor silence is the gentle texture at Strained; mechanical bite is reserved for Silent (curse posture).
Explicitly NOT created (ledger ruling and prompt). The Reclamation foreground uses shared patron state (active-patron offer), not a Dunmer-owned path enum.
One Reclamation foreground at a time is enforced by the active-patron/offer eligibility, not a state enum.
